scenarios.title: A｜轻松处理
scenarios.setting: 玩家在餐厅等了十五分钟，对方匆匆赶到。

turns.text: I’m so sorry I’m late. The traffic was terrible.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Don’t worry about it. I haven’t been waiting that long.

feedback.naturalExpression: Don’t worry about it. I haven’t been waiting that long.
feedback.explanation: 明确说出担心之处，方便对方针对顾虑解释；没有把担心直接说成已发生的事实。

choices.text: It’s okay. You made it—that’s what matters.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. You made it—that’s what matters.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: No worries. I just got a drink while I was waiting.

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. I just got a drink while I was waiting.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: I’ll forgive you this time. 😂

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll forgive you this time. 😂
feedback.explanation: “this time”配合笑脸，表达轻松的原谅；脱离玩笑语境可能显得居高临下。

choices.text: Never mind.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Don’t worry about it. I haven’t been waiting that long.
feedback.explanation: “Never mind”常表示算了、不必继续；回应道歉表示没关系，用“No worries / It’s okay”更清楚。

turns.text: Thanks. I was worried you’d be annoyed.

turns.prompt: 关于「约会对象迟到」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: You’re only fifteen minutes late. I’ll survive.

feedback.naturalExpression: You’re only fifteen minutes late. I’ll survive.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Nah, you’re fine. Let’s just enjoy the evening.

feedback.naturalExpression: Nah, you’re fine. Let’s just enjoy the evening.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: I was starting to wonder where you were, but it’s all good.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was starting to wonder where you were, but it’s all good.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

turns.prompt: 你想顺着对方的提议转入点餐，会怎么说？

choices.text: Definitely. I’m starving.

feedback.naturalExpression: Definitely. I’m starving.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Yeah, let’s take a look at the menu.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, let’s take a look at the menu.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: B｜表达不满
scenarios.setting: 对方迟到了将近四十分钟，而且没有提前发消息。

turns.text: I’m so sorry. I completely lost track of time.

turns.prompt: 你想坦诚表达等待时的不满，会怎么说？

choices.text: Honestly, I was getting pretty annoyed.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I was getting pretty annoyed.
feedback.explanation: “getting pretty annoyed”说明不耐烦正在加重，表达的是当前感受。

choices.text: I understand being late, but I wish you’d sent me a message.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand being late, but I wish you’d sent me a message.
feedback.explanation: 先理解迟到，再指出希望收到消息，讨论重点是沟通方式而非要求绝不迟到。

choices.text: I’ve been waiting for almost forty minutes without knowing what was going on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been waiting for almost forty minutes without knowing what was going on.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: I don’t mind waiting a little, but forty minutes is a lot.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t mind waiting a little, but forty minutes is a lot.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: You made me wait you for forty minutes.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I was getting pretty annoyed.
feedback.explanation: “wait”接人需要“for”，不能直接接“you”；可说“You made me wait for forty minutes”。

turns.text: You’re right. I should’ve texted you.

turns.prompt: 你想说明没有提前收到消息才是你在意的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah. That’s really what bothered me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. That’s really what bothered me.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Exactly. I just wanted to know you were still coming.

feedback.naturalExpression: Exactly. I just wanted to know you were still coming.
feedback.explanation: “exactly”强调信息吻合或需要精确确认，适合核对具体细节。

choices.text: Thanks for saying that. Just let me know next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for saying that. Just let me know next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: I don’t expect you to always be exactly on time, but communication matters.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t expect you to always be exactly on time, but communication matters.
feedback.explanation: “exactly”强调信息吻合或需要精确确认，适合核对具体细节。

turns.prompt: 关于「约会对象迟到」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Okay. Let’s start over.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let’s start over.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Thanks. I appreciate the apology.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I appreciate the apology.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: All right. Let’s not let it ruin the evening.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. Let’s not let it ruin the evening.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: C｜对方一直没有出现
scenarios.setting: 约定时间已经过去四十五分钟，对方没有出现，也没有发消息。

turns.prompt: 你想联系迟迟未出现的朋友，确认对方的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, are you still coming?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, are you still coming?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Hey, just checking—is everything okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, just checking—is everything okay?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: I’m at the restaurant. Are you on your way?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m at the restaurant. Are you on your way?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: We’ve been supposed to meet 45 minutes ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, are you still coming?
feedback.explanation: 过去约好某时见面用“were supposed to”；“45 minutes ago”与这里的完成时不搭配。

turns.prompt: 关于「约会对象迟到」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve been waiting for almost an hour, so I’m going to head home.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been waiting for almost an hour, so I’m going to head home.
feedback.explanation: “I’m going to”说明计划或去向，能让对方知道接下来的安排。

choices.text: I haven’t heard from you, so I’m going to leave. Hope everything’s okay.

feedback.naturalExpression: I haven’t heard from you, so I’m going to leave. Hope everything’s okay.
feedback.explanation: “I’m going to”说明计划或去向，能让对方知道接下来的安排。

choices.text: I’m heading out. Let me know what happened when you can.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m heading out. Let me know what happened when you can.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: I don’t think it’s reasonable to expect me to keep waiting without hearing from you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think it’s reasonable to expect me to keep waiting without hearing from you.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

turns.text: I’m so sorry. I completely messed up. Can I explain?

turns.prompt: 你想给迟到的朋友解释的机会，同时表达不满，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. What happened?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. What happened?
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: I’m willing to listen, but I’m pretty upset.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m willing to listen, but I’m pretty upset.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: Sure, but leaving me there without a message wasn’t okay.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure, but leaving me there without a message wasn’t okay.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: Honestly, I’m not sure I want to make another plan after tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I’m not sure I want to make another plan after tonight.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。
